name: Δ-8-Tetrahydrocannabinol
summary: Δ-8-Tetrahydrocannabinol is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: The pharmacodynamic profile of ∆8-THC is similar to that of ∆9-THC. It is a partial agonist of CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors with about half the potency of ∆9-THC in most but not all measures of biological activity.

uses.text: After the 2018 United States farm bill was signed, ∆8-THC products synthesized from industrial hemp by acid-catalyzed cyclization experienced a rise in popularity; THC products have been sold in licensed recreational cannabis and medical cannabis industries within the United States in California, Pennsylvania, and medicinally licensed in Michigan and Oregon.

sideEffects.text: As of 2022, there had been at least 104 adverse event reports made for ∆8-THC, and at least two deaths associated with ∆8-THC products. US national poison control centers received 2,362 exposure cases of Δ8-THC products between 1 January 2021 and 28 February 2022; 58% of these exposures involved adults, and 70% thought they required medical care.
